summary: Completed regression testing for the YUNG DSA artist site. Backend booking API and all exercised frontend flows passed, including desktop navigation, release filtering, video/lightbox modals, shows empty state, booking validation/submission, pending social feedback, mobile menu, and no horizontal overflow.

issues: /press-kit-placeholder.pdf is not a real PDF asset; the public URL responds with the SPA index HTML (content-type text/html), so the download control downloads/opens HTML rather than a PDF placeholder.

action_items: Add a real placeholder PDF at the linked public path or change the control to an explicitly labeled non-download placeholder until management supplies the kit.
critical_code_review_comments: Press kit href points to a missing static asset; SPA fallback returns index.html with HTTP 200, masking the broken download.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed booking inquiry through the public API and one UI test inquiry; no seeded application data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core desktop/mobile UI and booking integration are covered and passing. Recheck the press-kit static asset after it is added. The first two browser runs had test-only selector mapping errors; the final run used latest-release-section for the Music nav target and passed.
rca of the issue: The press link uses /press-kit-placeholder.pdf, but frontend/public contains only index.html. The frontend hosting fallback serves index.html for the missing path with status 200, so download does not deliver PDF bytes.
